Disclaimer
The Map Card component is provided as an optional UI element that can be used within a map interface. Please note:

The development and integration of the main Map component, including map markers, remain the responsibility of the product development team.
The Map Card component is offered as-is, to be placed inside the Map component for convenience.
This component will not be actively maintained from either the design system or SDK perspective. Future updates, bug fixes, or enhancements are not guaranteed.
Any customizations or adaptations needed should be handled by the respective product teams, as upstream support or guidance will be limited.
Teams choosing to use the Map Card component are responsible for ensuring compatibility, performance, and accessibility within their product.

Component Variants

Map size

The map comes in five sizes corresponding to the breakpoint tokens (XXL shown on previous Use Directives page).


Card state

Within any map size there are three primary card states (types), which correspond to the search bar state the first time the element is used.


Ongoing card states

For subsequent searches the card should remain in the returned state. The search bar can now independently change state - example below.


Default and selected map pins

When a map pin is selected the card show the individual details for the store or location the map pin represents.


Scrollable

If the content of the card exceeds it's height 'Scrollable' must be switched on to signal the behaviour to the user.
